triage.kind_span: This Schedule TO relates to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares, designated Series B Auction Market Preferred Shares

subject_names.span: The name of the subject company is The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust.

subject_tickers.span: The Funds outstanding common shares, par value $0.001 per share, are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the NYSE) under the symbol GDV

security_class.span: This Schedule TO relates to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares, designated Series B Auction Market Preferred Shares

price_basis.span: Calculated as the aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer, based upon a price of 96% of the liquidation preference of $25,000 per share (or $24,000 per share).

size_pct_outstanding.span: This Schedule TO relates to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares, designated Series B Auction Market Preferred Shares

size_shares.span: Calculated as the aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer

commencement_date.span: within 40 business days from the commencement of the Exchange Offer on March 17, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Exchange Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time (the Expiration Time), on April 14, 2021

spans: The Exchange Offer is conditioned on, among other things, holders of an aggregate of at least a majority of the outstanding Auction Rate Preferred Shares properly tendering (and not validly withdrawing) their Auction Rate Preferred Shares at or prior to the Expiration Date.
We reserve the right, in our sole and absolute discretion, to terminate the Exchange Offer at any time prior to the Expiration Date.

trigger_origin.span: The Funds Board met on February 24, 2021 to consider and approve the Exchange Offer.

notes: Original Schedule TO-I (issuer tender offer under Rule 13e-4) for an exchange offer, not a cash tender: The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust offers to exchange all outstanding unlisted Auction Rate Preferred Shares (Series B 2,647, Series C 3,244, Series E 480 outstanding as of March 16, 2021; 6,371 total) for 0.96 of a newly issued Series J Cumulative Term Preferred Share ($25,000 liquidation preference) per share plus cash in lieu of fractional shares and accrued unpaid dividends. The price is 96% of the $25,000 liquidation preference ($24,000 per share), not a percent of NAV, so price_basis is 'other' and price_pct_nav is null. subject_tickers: the tendered preferred series are not listed; GDV is the ticker printed for the fund's common shares. size_pct_outstanding 100 is as stated ('up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares'), meaning all Auction Rate Preferred Shares; the fund's listed Series G and H preferred are not in the offer. Conditions: the only condition stated in the excerpt is the majority-of-ARPS minimum tender (Bank of America holds 94.0% and agreed to tender 100% under a Share Exchange Agreement); the full 'Conditions to the Exchange Offer' section lies after the excerpt cut. board_discretion is from the stated right to terminate the offer in the Fund's sole and absolute discretion at any time before expiration. trigger_origin: the Board approved the offer on February 24, 2021 to reduce dividend obligations at the maximum auction rate and simplify capital structure; it is negotiated with the 94% holder, so 'other' is a possible reading. Expected settlement April 19, 2021. No results in this filing.
